mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal impairment; foscarnet increases risk of electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) which may potentiate cefepime neurotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, monitor serum electrolytes regularly, and consider alternative antivirals if possible; assess for signs of cefepime neurotoxicity.
